extra_fields.description: Including values from this option will increase the amount of data included in the response

fields.contract: An object consisting of various extra contract related details
fields.idealfors: An array containing strings representing what kind of groups the property is ideal for
fields.allowances: An array of strings describing what is allowed at the property e.g. smoking, pets
fields.events: An array of event objects describing upcoming open homes and auctions
fields.links: An array of link objects containing a link type and url
fields.bookings: An array of objects indicating when the listing is booked out for the next 3 months
fields.images: An array of image objects containing a main url and various thumb sizes. All urls require an http: or https: value to be prefixed to render correctly if being rendered outside of a standard web browser
fields.floorplans: An array of floorplan image objects containing a main url and various thumb sizes. All urls require an http: or https: value to be prefixed to render correctly if being rendered outside of a standard web browser
fields.highlights: An array of listing highlight objects containing the description and a priority (only available for accounts in UK region)
fields.rooms: An array of listing room objects containing the room type, description, dimensions, priority and images (only available accounts in UK region)
fields.tags: An array of tags that describe the property in various ways
fields.features: An array of strings representing the 'fixed' features available at the property
fields.views: An array of views that the property has
fields.advert_internet: An object representing the internet advert for a property
fields.advert_brochure: An object representing the brochure advert for a property. If unavailable, the internet advert is returned
fields.advert_stocklist: An object representing the stocklist advert for a property. If unavailable, the brcohure advert is returned. If the brochure advert is unavailable, the internet advert is returned.
fields.rural: An object containing text under various keys that represents the state of certain aspects of a rural property
fields.documents: An array of objects. Each object contains a document type, name and url
fields.subcategories: An array containing strings representing listing sub categories
fields.meta: An object containing various short meta data string relating to the property - parking notes, zoning, highlights etc.
fields.epc: An object containing EPC data and urls of EPC charts. All urls require an http: or https: value to be prefixed to render correctly if being rendered outside of a standard web browser (only available accounts in UK region)
fields.portal_watermarks: An array of listing images with watermarks applied keyed by portal profile id
fields.portal_main_image_index: An array of listing image indexes indicating the image to appear as the main image keyed by portal profile id
fields.cf.properties.*: All property custom fields. Do not request all fields unless you require them. Describe the model with a token to access specific custom fields
fields.cf.listings.*: All listing custom fields. Do not request all fields unless you require them. Describe the model with a token to access specific custom fields
